purpose: Prevent false non-events and reporting/camera availability leakage in Jubilee validation.
observed_non_event_requires: Known observation effort in the target shoreline cell and predawn window.
At least one qualified direct or human/camera observation channel was actually available and fresh.
No confirmed Jubilee evidence in that visible/observed cell and interval.
Camera view quality or human survey effort was sufficient to detect the class of event being labeled absent.
No source outage, darkness/obstruction, stale frame, or unverified report gap is being reinterpreted as a negative.
leakage_rules: Do not use information first available after forecast issuance as a predictor for that forecast.
Same-day public reports may be used only in a detection/nowcast layer if available_at precedes the forecast timestamp.
Do not allow event-driven extra observation effort to make positives look systematically better observed than controls without explicit detectability adjustment.
No-report days are UNKNOWN unless observation effort meets the observed_non_event requirements.

prospective_control_strategy.preferred_window: same pre-dawn/dawn windows used by Jubilee Dawn Timing
prospective_control_strategy.method: Log daily camera health, view quality, public-camera structured observations and any deliberate human field checks regardless of model risk level; later match clean non-event mornings to confirmed events.
